usedFor: MailerLite holds subscribers, and “Spam Complaint” there can start “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy, which runs AI agents.

bestTemplate.name: “Spam Complaint” in MailerLite, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: It sends a chat request with custom variables to a chosen AI agent when a subscriber marks a campaign spam.

watchOut: “Subscriber Opened Campaign” fires on each open, so “Call AI Agent Instantly” can run repeatedly for one person.
